29.04.2025 (भारत के राजपत्र, असाधारण, भाग-॥, खंड-3, उपखंड (ii) F प्रकाशित) (आगे “उक्त अधिसूचना” कहलाएगी) 
द्वारा, रेलवे अधिनियम, 7989 (7989 का 24) की धारा 20क की उपधारा (॥) के अंतर्गत, केंद्र सरकार ने उक्त अधिसूचना 
के साथ संलग्न अनुसूची में निर्दिष्ट भूमि का अधिग्रहण करने का अपना अभिप्राय घोषित किया था, ताकि विशेष रेलवे 
परियोजना के क्रियान्वयन, रखरखाव, प्रबंधन एवं संचालन के लिए, उक्त अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिद्रिष्ट भूमि 
को गुजरात राज्य में जिला वडोदरा में पश्चिम रेलवे पर वडोदरा डिवीजन के वडोदरा-गेरतपुर खंड के बीच किमी 404/24- 
26 पर एल सी नंबर 238 के बदले में 2 लेन रोड ओवर ब्रिज (आरओबी) का निर्माण नाम की विशेष रेल परियोजना के 
निष्पादन के लिये आवश्यक है ऐसी भूमि के अर्जन करने के आशय की घोषणा करती है; 


और, जबकि उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20क की उपधारा (4) के अंतर्गत दिनांक 06 मई 
2025 को दैनिक स्थानीय गुजराती समाचार पत्र "दिव्या भाकर", दिनांक 06 मई 2025 को, हिंदी समाचार पत्र "वडोदरा 
सौराष्ट्र"' और दिनांक 06 मई 2025 को अंग्रेजी समाचार पत्र "द इंडियन एक्सप्रेस" में प्रकाशित किया गया था; 


और, सक्षम प्राधिकारी को कोई आपत्ति प्राप्त नहीं हुई है;

और, सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा QOS को उप.घारा (4) के अनुसरण में केंद्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट सौंप दी है; 


अत:, अब, केंद्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी से उक्त रिपोर्ट के प्राप्त होने पर और रेल अधिनियम, 7989 की धारा 
205 की उप-धारा (॥) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह धोषणा करती है कि इससे उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिद्धिष्ट 
भूमि पूर्वाक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जित की जाएगी; 


और केंद्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 203 की उप-धारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह और घोषणा करती है कि 


इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशित होने पर इससे उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिद्धिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर 
अनन्य रूप से केंद्रीय सरकार में निहित होगी।

का.आ. 889(a).— केन्द्रीय सरकार, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम १९५६ (१९५६ का ४८) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उप-धारा (॥) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह समाधान 
हो जाने के पश्चात्‌ कि महाराष्ट्र राज्य के सोलापुर जिले में राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग संख्या ६५२ के कि.मी. ५०/००० से कि.मी. 
७०/७०९ तक के भूखंड (नरूदुर्ग से अक्कलकोट) का निर्माण (चौडाकरने, दो/चार लेन पेव्ड शोल्डर सहित का 
बनाने, आदि) अनुरक्षण, प्रबन्धन और प्रचालन के लोक प्रयोजन के लिए वह भूमि अपेक्षित है जिसका संक्षिप्त वर्णन नीचे 
अनुसूची में दिया गया है, ऐसी भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा करती है। 


कोई भी व्यक्ति, जो भूमि में हितबद्ध है, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा ३ग की उपधारा (१) के अधीन पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन 
के लिए ऐसी भूमि के उपयोग पर राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से इक्कीस दिन के भीतर अपनी आपत्ति 
प्रकट कर सकेगा | 


ऐसी प्रत्येक आक्षेप सक्षम प्राधिकारी, तथा उपजिल्हाधिकारी भूसंपादन क्र.३ सोलापुर को लिखित रूप में किया 
जायगा और उसमें उसके आधार अधिकथित किए जाएंगे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी, आपत्तिकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप में या किसी 
विधि व्यवसायी द्वारा सुने जाने का अवसर देगा और ऐसी आक्षेपो की सुनवाई के पश्चात्‌ तथा ऐसी और जाँच करने के 
पश्चात्‌, यदि कोई हो, जिसे सक्षम प्राधिकारी आवश्यक समझे, आदेश द्वारा या तो आपत्तियों को अनुज्ञात कर सकेगा या 
अननुज्ञात कर सकेगा |

S.O. 888(E).— In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management Construction of a 4-lane bypass 
from Thekma village (existing chainage km 36/300 of NH-l28A) to Gosai Ki Bazar Bypass (existing chainage km 
242/500 of NH-28) with a total length of 8.35 km, along with widening of NH-!28A from 2-Lane to 4-Lane from 
Smt. Lata Mangeshkar Junction to Prasad Institute for a length of 4.70 km, and Strengthening of NH-l28A from 
Prasad Institute to Mohammedpura Junction, covering a length of 4.35 km (total length: 54.85 km), in the state of 
Uttar Pradesh on EPC mode as a part of Prayagraj-Jaunpur-Azamgarh-Dohrighat Section. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section (l) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Chief Revenue Office/Special Land 
Acquisition Officer, Azamgarh in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give 
the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such 
objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either 
allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

हो जाने के पश्चात्‌ कि तेलंगाना राज्य के हनमकोंडा जिले में NH-353C के कि.मी. 92.000 से कि.मी. 408.556 तक के

के अपने आशय की घोषणा करती है। 


कोई भी व्यक्ति, जो उक्त भूमि में हितबद्ध है, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3ग की उप-धारा (॥) के अधीन पूर्वोक्त

आपत्ति प्रकट कर सकेगा |

उसके आधार अधिकथित किए जाएंगे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी, आपत्तिकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप में या किसी विधिक पेशेवर

notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(l) of 
section 3C of the said Act.

out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in 
person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if 
any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections.

के अंतर्गत जारी तथा भारत का राजपत्र, असाधारण, भाग 1, खंड 3, उप-खंड (1), दिनांक 18 सितंबर, 2025, (इसके पश्चात्‌ 
उक्त अधिसूचना के रूप में संदर्भित) को प्रकाशित भारत सरकार, रेल मंत्रालय (रेलवे बोर्ड), संख्यांक का.आ. 4228 (ई), 17 
सितंबर, 2025, की अधिसूचना द्वारा उक्त अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि अर्थात्‌ आंध्र प्रदेश राज्य के 
तिरुपति जिले में विशेष रेलवे परियोजना अर्थात्‌ “ये्पेंड-पुडि (25.36 कि.मी.)स्टेशनों के बीच बाईपास लाइन” के निष्पादन, 
अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन, और प्रचालन के प्रयोजन हेतु आवश्यक भूमि को अर्जित करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी; 


और जबकि, उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 200 की उप-धारा (4) के अंतर्गत दैनिक 
समाचारापत्रों, साक्षी, आंध्र TAT (तेलुगु) और द न्यू संडे एक्सप्रेंस (अंग्रेजी)” में 05 अक्तूबर, 2025 को के. सूर्यनारायण, मुख्य 
इंजीनियर-!, निर्माण संगठन, सिकंदराबाद द्वारा प्रकाशित किया गया था; 

और चूंकि संवैधानिक समय सीमा के भीतर कोई आपत्ति दर्ज नहीं की गई है. 


और जबकि, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20ई की उप-धारा (1) के अनुसरण में सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने इसकी रिपोर्ट केंद्र 
सरकार को प्रस्तुत कर दी है;

NOTIFICATION 
Secunderabad, the 8th April, 2026 


5.0. 1862(E).—Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of Railways 
(Railway Board), number, 5.0. 4228 (E) dated the 17th September 2025 published in Gazette of India, Extraordinary, 
Part II, section 3 Sub-section(ii), dated the 18th September 2025 (here in after referred to as the said notification) and 
issued under sub-section(1) of section 20(A) of the Railway Act, 1989 (24 of 1989), the Central Government declares its 
intention to acquire the land specified in the schedule annexed to the said notification for the purpose of execution, 
maintenance, management and operation of Special Railway Project, namely “Bypass line between Yerpedu—Pudi 
stations (25.36 Km.)”, in Tirupati district in the state of Andhra Pradesh. 


And whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily newspapers namely “Sakshi,Andhra 
Prabha (Telugu) and The New Sunday Express (English)” on 05th October 2025 by K.Suryanaryana, Chief Engineer-III, 


Construction Organization Secunderabad under sub section (4) of section 20A of the said Act; 
And whereas no objections have been filed within the statutory time limit. 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of 20E of the said Act, the competent authority has submitted its 
report to the Central Government; 


Now therefore, upon receipt of the report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers conferred 
by sub-section (1) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the lands specified in the 
schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose;

राजमार्ग प्राधिकरण /राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग एवं अवसंरचना विकास निगम लिमिटेड इस संबंध में आदेश द्वारा निर्दिष्ट कर 


सकता है।

५. ट्रांसपोर्टर, यानों को सड़कों पर लाने से पहले, किसी भी वस्तु जैसे SiS, पोल, साइनबोर्ड को हटाने के लिए, 
ट्रांसमिशन लाइन बंद कराना इत्यादि के लिए, राज्य/संघ राज्य क्षेत्र सरकार के संबंधित विभागों से आवश्यक पूर्व 
अनुमति प्राप्त करेगा और इस तरह के प्रतिबंधों का पालन करेगा जैसा कि राज्य / संघ राज्य क्षेत्र / भारतीय राष्ट्रीय 
राजमार्ग प्राधिकरण/ राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग एवं अवसंरचना विकास निगम लिमिटेड इस संबंध में आदेश द्वारा विनिर्दिष्ट 
करता है। राज्य/संघ राज्य क्षेत्र सरकार द्वारा अनुमत, किसी भी वस्तु को हटाने और पुनर्विकास कराने की लागत 
मैसर्स जेएम sett (प्रा) लिमिटेड द्वारा वहन की जाएगी। 


५. ट्रांसपोर्टर बड़े आकार के कार्गो को देखते हुए, ऐसे यानों की प्रत्येक आवाजाही के संबंध में राज्य सरकार/भारतीय 
राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग प्राधिकरण/ राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग एवं अवसंरचना विकास निगम लिमिटेड द्वारा इस संबंध में निर्दिष्ट 
प्राधिकरण या अधिकारी को कम से कम दस दिन पहले सूचना देगा। ऐसे प्रत्येक गमनागमन के लिए संबंधित 
प्राधिकारी द्वारा समय निर्धारित किया जाना चाहिए। 


vi. यदि ऐसा किसी राज्य/संघ राज्य क्षेत्र/भारतीय राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग प्राधिकरण/ राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग एवं अवसंरचना 
विकास निगम लिमिटेड के लोक निर्माण विभाग द्वारा निर्देशित किया जाता है, तो लदे हुए यानों को उस राज्य/संघ 
राज्य क्षेत्र में सड़कों पर पुलों के ऊपर या नीचे से गुजरने की अनुमति नहीं दी जाएगी और ऐसे मामलों में आवेदकों को 
नदियों/नालों को पार करने के लिए संबंधित प्राधिकारियों से अनुमति प्राप्त करने के बाद, अपने खर्च पर, अपनी

vil. ट्रांसपोर्टर राज्य / संघ राज्य क्षेत्र / भारतीय राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग प्राधिकरण/ राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग एवं अवसंरचना

जहां सड़कों या सड़क संरचनाओं/ पुलों / अन्य सड़क प्रयोक्ताओं/ व्यक्ति को प्रत्यक्ष या अप्रत्यक्ष रूप से कोई नुकसान

xi. सड़क पर चलने के लिए ट्रैलरों की अधिकतम गति 5 कि.मी./घंटा से अधिक नहीं होनी चाहिए।

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the l3th April, 2026 


S.O. 874(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH848 in the 
stretch of land from Km. 0 to Km. 22 (Taluka Seva Sadan Near NH -48 , Pardi) in the district of VALSAD in the state 
of GUJARAT, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 

Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(l) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 

Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority in writing and shall set out the grounds 
thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a 
legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the 
Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 

Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be final. 

The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 13th April, 2026 

S.O. 1886(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways Act, 
1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for the 
public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH301 in the 
stretch of landfrom Design (Km 10+680 to 13+300 Km and Km 47+160 to km 47+600) in the villages of (Minjee, 
Sangrah and Gailing ) in the district of KARGIL in the Union Territory of Ladakh, hereby declares its intention to 
acquire such land. 

Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 

Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, DEPUTY COMMISSIONER, 
KARGIL in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an 


[भाग 1---खण्ड 3(ii)] भारत का राजपत्र : असाधारण 11 


opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and 
after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or 
disallow the objections. 

Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

S.O. 1887(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways Act, 
1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for the

the stretch of land from Km. 17.200 to Km. 42.045 (West Champaran) in the district of WEST CHAMPARAN in the 
state of BIHAR, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 

Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 

Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, District Land Acquisition Officer in 
writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of 
being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making 
such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the 
objections. 

Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be final. 

The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 5810 तारीख 16/12/2025, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग Ul, खण्ड 3, उपखंड () में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा मध्य प्रदेश राज्य के निवाड़ी जिले में Connecting 
Bypass के कि.मी. 0 से कि.मी.15.5 तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चोड़ाकरने / चार लेन का बनाने, आदि), 
अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने 
आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 

और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख 19/12/2025 को 
“फ्री प्रेस” , 19/12/2025 को “दैनिक भास्कर” दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 

जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और उसका 
उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया;

रिपोर्ट दे दी है; 

अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की 
उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 

और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि इस 
अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप से 
केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी |

5.0. 883(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by clause (l) of Section 20A of the Railways Act,l989 
(24 of 989) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for the public 
purpose, the land, the brief description of which has been given in schedule annexed hereto, is required for purpose of 
execution, maintenance, management and operation of Special Railway Project, namely Khalilabad -Bahraich New 
railway line project (240.66 Km ) in the Tehsil Balrampur of Balrampur District in State of Uttar Pradesh hereby 
declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within a period of thirty days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition and use of such land for the aforesaid purpose 
under sub-section (l) of section 20D of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority namely, Additional District 
Magistrate(Judicial), Balrampur Uttar Pradesh in writing and shall set out the grounds there of, and the Competent 
Authority shall give the objector the opportunity of being heard, either in person or by legal practitioner and may, after 
hearing such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by 
order, either allowor disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 20D of the said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be inspected by 
the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

5.0. 1900(E).— In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 20A of the Railways 
(Amendment) Act, 1989 (24/89) (hereinafter referred as the said Act.), the Central Government, after being satisfied 
that for the public purpose, the Land, brief description of which is given in the schedule annexed here to is required for 
the execution of Special Railway Project, namely, " Construction of Railway Overbridge No. 77 at NH-28 Railway 
Station (Chainage 53600) in Bansi Tehsil, Siddharthnagar District, Uttar Pradesh. ", hereby declares its intention 


to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may within a period of (30) thirty days from the date of publication of 
the notification in the Official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition of such land for the aforesaid purpose under 


sub-section(1) of section 20D of the said Act. 


Every Such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely Special Land Acquisition Officer, 
Siddhartnagar Uttar Pradesh in writing and shall set out the ground there of, and the competent authority Authority 
shall give the objector the opportunity of being heard, either in person or by legal practitioner and may, after hearing 
such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, 


either allowor disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 20D of the said Act shall be final.

5.0. 1902(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by clause (1) of Section 20A of the Railways Act, 1989 
(24 of 1989) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for the public 
purpose, the land, the brief description of which has been given in schedule annexed hereto, is required for purpose of 
execution, maintenance, management and operation of Special Railway Project, namely Khalilabad —Bahraich New 
railway line project (240.66 Km ) in the Tehsil Ekauna of Shrawasti District in State of Uttar Pradesh hereby 


declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within a period of thirty days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition and use of such land for the aforesaid purpose 
under sub-section (1) of section 20D of the said Act.

objector the opportunity of being heard, either in person or by legal practitioner and may, after hearing such objections 


and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allowor 


disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 20D of the said Act shall be final.

the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

NOTIFICATION 
Gorakhpur, the 13th April, 2026 


5.0. 1903(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by clause (1) of Section 20A of the Railways Act, 1989 
(24 of 1989) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for the public 
purpose, the land, the brief description of which has been given in schedule annexed hereto, is required for purpose of 
execution, maintenance, management and operation of Special Railway Project, namely Khalilabad —Bahraich New 
railway line project (240.66 Km ) in the Tehsil Bhinga of Shrawasti District in State of Uttar Pradesh hereby 


declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within a period of thirty days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition and use of such land for the aforesaid purpose 
under sub-section (1) of section 20D of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority namely, Additional District Magistrate(F/R), 
Shrawasti Uttar Pradesh in writing and shall set out the grounds there of, and the Competent Authority shall give the 
objector the opportunity of being heard, either in person or by legal practitioner and may, after hearing such objections 
and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allowor 


disallow the objections. 
Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 20D of the said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be inspected by 


the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

5.0. 898(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by clause (l) of Section 20A of the Railways Act,l989 
(24 of 989) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for the public 
purpose, the land, the brief description of which has been given in schedule annexed hereto, is required for purpose of 
execution, maintenance, management and operation of Special Railway Project, namely Khalilabad -Bahraich New 
railway line project (240.66 Km ) in the Tehsil Khalilabad of Santkabirnagar District in State of Uttar Pradesh 
hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within a period of thirty days from the date of publication of 
this notification in the Official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition and use of such land for the aforesaid 
purpose under sub-section () of section 20D of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority namely, Additional District 
Magistrate(F/R), Santkabirnagar Uttar Pradesh in writing and shall set out the grounds there of, and the Competent 
Authority shall give the objector the opportunity of being heard, either in person or by legal practitioner and may, after 
hearing such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by 
order, either allowor disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 20D of the said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be inspected by 
the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

अधिनियम 2008 के रूप में संदर्भित) की धारा 20क की उपधारा (॥) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, केन्द्रीय 
सरकार का यह समाधान हो जाने के बाद कि लोक प्रयोजन के लिए, भूमि, जिसका संक्षिप्त विवरण इसके साथ संलग्न अनुसूची 
में दिया गया है, विशेष रेल परियोजना के निष्पादन के लिए अपेक्षित है, गुजरात राज्य के भरूच जिले में जंबुसर - कावी 
आमान परिवर्तन परीयोजना. 
उक्त भूमि में रुचि रखने वाला कोई भी व्यक्ति, सरकारी राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से तीस 
दिनों की अवधि के भीतर, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20 डी की उप-धारा (|) के तहत पूर्वोक्त उद्देश्य के लिए ऐसी भूमि के 
अधिग्रहण और उपयोग पर आपत्ति उठा सकता है; 


ऐसी प्रत्येक आपत्ति सक्षम प्राधिकारी नामत प्रांत अधिकारी, जंबुसर, जिला भरूच, को लिखित रूप में की जाएगी 
और उसके आधार निर्धारित करेगा और सक्षम प्राधिकारी आपत्तिकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप से या कानूनी व्यवसायी द्वारा सुनवाई

उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20 (डी) की उप-धारा (॥) के तहत सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा किया गया कोई भी आदेश 
अंतिम होगा।

उपरोक्त कार्यालय में इच्छुक व्यक्ति द्वारा निरीक्षण किया जा सकता है।

NOTIFICATION 
Mumbai, the 3rd October, 2025 


G.S.R. 280(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section(I) of section 20A of the Railways 
Act,l989 (24 of 989) (hereinafter referred in as the said act 2008), the Central Government after being satisfied that 
for the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which has given in the schedule annexed hereto, is required for 
execution of the Special Railway Project, namely, Jambusar - Kavi Gauge Conversion Project in District Bharuch in 
the State of Gujarat, hereby declares its intention to acquired such land ; 


Any person interested in the said land may, within a period of thirty days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition and use of such land for the aforesaid purpose 
under sub-section(I) of section 20D of the said Act; 


Every such objection shall be made to the competent authority, namely, Prant Officer Jambusar, District 
Bharuch, in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the competent authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by legal practitioner and may. After hearing all such objections and after 
making such further enquiry, if any as the competent authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the 
objections; 


Any order made by the competent authority under sub-section (II) of section 20(D) of the said act shall be final.

MINISTRY OF RAILWAYS 
(South Central Railway) 
NOTIFICATION 
Secunderabad, the l2th April, 2026 


5.0. 920(E).— Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of Railways 
(Railway Board), number, S.O 4228 (E) dated the 7th September 2025 published in Gazette of India, Extraordinary, 
Part II, section 3 Sub-section(ii), dated the l8th September 2025 (here in after referred to as the said notification) and 
issued under sub-section(l) of section 20(A) of the Railway Act, 989(24 of 989), the Central Government declares 
its intention to acquire the land specified in the schedule annexed to the said notification for the purpose of execution, 
maintenance, management and operation of Special Railway Project, namely “Bypass line between Yerpedu—Pudi 
stations (25.36Km.)”, in Tirupati district in the state of Andhra Pradesh. 


And whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily newspapers namely “Sakshi, 
Andhra Prabha (Telugu) and The New Sunday Express (English)” on 05th October 2025 by K.Suryanaryana, Chief 
Engineer-III, Construction Organization Secunderabad under sub section (4) of section 20A of the said Act; 


And whereas no objections have been filed within the statutory time limit. 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section () of 20E of the said Act, the competent authority has submitted its 
report to the Central Government; 


Now therefore, upon receipt of the report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers conferred 
by sub-section () of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the lands specified in the 
schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 

And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government here by 
declares that on publication of this notification in the official Gazette, the land specified in the schedule annexed here 
to shall vest absolutely in the Central Government free from all encumbrances

BUREAU OF ENERGY EFFICIENCY 
DRAFT NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the l5th April, 2026 

F. No. 8/I/BEE/DISCOM/2026.— In exercise of the powers conferred by clause (9) of sub-section (2) of 
section 58, read with clause (q) of sub-section (2) of section 3 of the Energy Conservation Act, 200 (52 of 200), 
(hereinafter referred to as the Act) and in supersession of the notification of the Bureau of Energy Efficiency (the Bureau) 
published vide number |8/l/BEE/DISCOM/202], dated the 6th October, 202] and its subsequesnt amendment vide 
dated the 28th October, 2022, except as respects things done or omitted to be done before such supersession, the Bureau, 
with the previous approval of the Central Government, hereby proposes to make the following draft regulations; 


The draft regulations are hereby published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, as required by sub-section 
(.) of section 58 of the said Act, for the information of all the persons likely to be affected thereby and inviting their 
suggestions and objections (if any); and the notice is hereby given that the said draft regulations shall be taken into 
consideration on or after the expiry of a period of thirty days from the date of their publication in the Gazette of India, 
Extraordinary; 

Objections or suggestions, if any, may be addressed to the Director-General, Bureau of Energy Efficiency, 
Ministry of Power, 4th Floor, Sewa Bhawan, R.K. Puram, Sector-l, New Delhi-!l0066, through post or email at 
helpdesk @beeindia. gov. in. 


Objections or suggestions which may be received from the persons with respect to the said draft regulations 
before the expiry of the period of thirty days specified in para | above, shall be taken into consideration by the Bureau 
of Energy Efficiency. 


Draft Regulations 


l. Short title, application and commencement. (|) These regulations may be called the Bureau of Energy Efficiency 
(Energy Audit and Energy Accounting in Electricity Distribution Companies) Regulations, 2026. 


(2) These regulations shall apply to all electricity distribution companies specified as designated consumer. 
(3) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 


2. Conduct of annual energy audit. () Every electricity distribution company shall conduct an annual energy audit 

for every financial year through an accredited energy auditing firm. 
(2) The annual energy audit report shall be prepared in accordance with the indicative structure specified in 
Annexure-I and as per the format specified in Annexure-III. 
(3) The report shall be submitted to the Bureau and respective State Designated Agency within a period of four 
months from the expiry of the relevant financial year. 
(4) Where anew electricity distribution company is established after the commencement of these regulations, such 
electricity distribution company shall conduct its first annual energy audit on completion of the first financial year 
from the date of being notified as designated consumer. 
Explanation. — If any entity created as a result of merger, demerger, slump sale, acquisition, change of control 
or any other corporate restructuring of, or involving, any existing electricity distribution company, such entity 
shall not be considered as a new electricity distribution company for the purposes of this sub-regulation. 

3. Conduct of quarterly energy accounting. (l) Every electricity distribution company shall undertake quarterly 
energy accounting for each quarter of the financial year through its energy manger as per the format specified in 
Annexure-II. 

(2) the quarterly energy accounting report shall be submitted to the Bureau and respective State Designated Agency 
within forty-five days from the date of the closure of each quarter of the financial year. 

4. Monitoring and Verification (|) The accredited energy auditing firm, while carrying out the energy audit shall 
verify, analyse and process the data with respect to— 

(i) consistency and accuracy of data; and 

(ii) reducing losses for the electricity distribution company. 
(2) The annual energy audit report shall identify the areas of energy leakage, wastage or inefficient use for initiating 
target based corrective action. 

(3) The electricity distribution company shall maintain all supporting records relating to quarterly energy accounting 

and annual energy audit and shall make such records available to the Bureau of Energy Efficiency, State Designated 

Agency or any authorised agency, as and when required. 

KRUSHNA CHANDRA PANIGRAHY, Director General

NOTIFICATION 


Secunderabad, the 13th April, 2026 
S.O. 1919(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (I) of section 20A of the Railway Act, 


1989 (24 of 1989) (hereinafter referred as in as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for the

public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule annexed hereto, is required for the 
purpose of execution of the Special Railway Project namely, “Third line between Gudur - Renigunta stations (83.17 
Km)”, in Tirupati district in the state of Andhra Pradesh, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land: 

Any person interested in the said land may, within a period of thirty days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the official gazette, raise objections to the acquisition and use of such land for the aforesaid purpose 
under sub- section (1) of section 20D of the said act: 

Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely Joint Collector (land acquisition), 
Tirupati, Tirupati district in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority namely Joint 
Collector (land acquisition), Tirupati, Tirupati district shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in 
person or by legal practitioner and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, 
as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 

Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (I) of section 20(D) of the said act shall be 
final. 

The land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be inspected 
by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.
